protocol.purpose: Rebuild KelpWatch outcomes around Giraldo field sites at matched local supports and diagnose prediction errors without generalizing the field subset coastwide.

overlap_control.cluster_rule: DBSCAN connected components at twice the support radius
overlap_control.use: cluster-robust inference and leave-cluster-out audit; do not interpret overlapping site buffers as independent ecological replicates

ecological_axes.grazing_log1p: log1p(red urchin density + purple urchin density)
ecological_axes.rock_probability: mean probability of rock in the surveyed site polygon
ecological_axes.kelp_species_contrast: log1p(bull kelp density) minus log1p(giant kelp density)
